newsitem.title: USA: Tropical storm Danny seen making landfall Fri--NHC.
newsitem.headline: Tropical storm Danny seen making landfall Fri--NHC.

text.p: The following update on tropical storm Danny was issued by the National Hurricane Center (NHC) in Coral Gables, Florida, at 1600 CDT/2100 GMT: Position: Lat. 28.5 degrees North

Track: East-Northeast Speed: 2 mph Strength: 60 mph sustained maximum wind Comments: A tropical storm warning and hurricane watch remain in effect from Cameron, Louisiana, to Orange Beach, eastern Alabama.
Landfall is expected within this zone sometime early Friday, with fluctuation in intensity likely before landfall.
Isolated tornadoes are possible along the storm's path. A 4-5 foot storm surge above normal tides and heavy rains are expected along the coast of southeastern Louisiana and southern Mississippi.
